hubOrigin.headline: China Secures 100 Million Doses of BioNTech Vaccine

primaryEvidence.claim: Fosun Pharma obtained the exclusive right to develop and commercialize BioNTech's COVID-19 mRNA vaccine products in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan.
For mainland/Hong Kong/Macau sales during the agreed period, Fosun/BioNTech share annual sales gross profit 65%/35% for finished-product supply and 60%/40% when BioNTech supplies bulk formulation.

Subject to mainland approval and Fosun placing orders, BioNTech committed to supply no fewer than 100 million doses to mainland China in 2021; first 50 million doses required EUR250m of advance payments in two stages.

eventIncrementalEarningsBridge.baseline: Before the December amendment, Fosun already held exclusive regional commercialization rights but exact mainland supply quantity and gross-profit sharing for the vaccine remained less concretely defined.
newEventDelta: At least 100 million-dose 2021 mainland supply commitment if approved and ordered.
Explicit 65% Fosun share of annual sales gross profit for finished-product supply, or 60% for bulk formulation supply.
eventIncrementalEarningsBridge.keyCondition: Mainland regulatory approval and actual orders
eventIncrementalEarningsBridge.falsifier: Approval delay/failure, no material mainland orders, unfavorable realized pricing/costs, or supply constraints preventing delivery.
